# Upload options

Control how firmware is uploaded to the board.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`upload_port`](./upload-port.md) | An upload port which `uploader` tool uses for a firmware flashing |
| [`upload_protocol`](./upload-protocol.md) | A protocol that `uploader` tool uses to talk to a board |
| [`upload_speed`](./upload-speed.md) | A connection speed (baud rate) which `uploader` tool uses when sending firmware to a board |
| [`upload_flags`](./upload-flags.md) | An extra flags for `uploader` tool |
| [`upload_resetmethod`](./upload-resetmethod.md) | A custom reset method |
| [`upload_command`](./upload-command.md) | A custom upload command which overwrites a default from development platform |
